verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v1: ḥawmatī kaʿbahu l-ʿulūmi ʾaṭūfu waliqalbī fī ḥijratayhā l-wuqūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v2: kaʿbahu lā yuraddu fīhā rajāʾu walanā ʿindahā naṣību naẓīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v3: ʾassasathā yadu l-ḥakīmi faʾaḍḥat maljaʾa n-nāsi yantaḥīhā l-ʾulūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v4: hāka fardā ʿalā r-ruʾūsi tasāmā fahwa lil-muʾuminīna quṭbu ʿaṭūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v5: yā ʾabā bakri lladhī fīhi naḥẓā kulla ḥaẓẓi wafīhi yaḥmī l-ʾasīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v6: lā ʾarā khayraka l-jaliyyī bifāni baʿda mā qultu lil-ʿaliyyī yā raʾūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v7: ʾinnaka l-murtaḍā bikulli makāni qad badat min thanā ʿulāka l-ḥurūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v8: mā badā lī badā likulli madīni ʾanta shamsu mā fī samāka l-kusūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v9: kam ʾatā minka lil-murīdi nawālu waliʿāni minka l-milā wan-naṣīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v10: ʾanta liṣ-ṣāliḥīna ḥibbu rabīzu walidhī l-ʿilmi ṣāḥibu waʾalīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v11: wudda law kunta fīhi khayra ʾimāmi sālifa d-dahri ʾaw laḥāhu l-ʾulūfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v12: ʾahluka l-fāʾiqūna khiltu nujūmā ʾidh ʾabū l-faḍli fī ḥimāhum khalīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v13: sāmiḥan ḥubbaka lladhī kalla ʿammā yuḥsinu l-madḥa ʾidh lawāhu ẓ-ẓarīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v14: bayda ʾanna l-fuʾāda fīhi ʿtiqādu ṣaḥḥa billāhi qad darāhu llaṭīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v15: faʿalā l-hāshimiyyī ʾazkā ṣalāti fahwa fī ʿarshi dhī l-jalāli munīfu
verses.hawmati-ka-batu-l-ulumi-atufu-c1-v16: hakadhā l-ʾālu wal-ʾulā qad qafawhum maʿa man fī nidhārihim qad yaṭūfu
